data.description: Main dataset containing 2,000 synthetic social media user records with 34 behavioral, demographic, and engagement features across 8 major platforms.
data.name: social_media_user_behavior.csv

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each user (format: USR00001 to USR02000)

columns.name: age
columns.description: Age of the user in years. Range: 13 to 65.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender identity of the user. Values: Male, Female, Non-binary, Prefer not to say.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country of residence. Covers 10 countries: Pakistan, India, USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Germany, Australia, Brazil, Nigeria.

columns.name: profession
columns.description: User occupation or job role. Values: Student, Engineer, Designer, Teacher, Freelancer, Doctor, Marketer, Entrepreneur, Researcher, Other.

columns.name: primary_platform
columns.description: The social media platform the user spends the most time on. Values: Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Pinterest.

columns.name: platforms_used_count
columns.description: Total number of different social media platforms the user actively uses. Range: 1 to 5.

columns.name: daily_usage_hours
columns.description: Average number of hours spent on social media per day. Range: 0.5 to 12 hours.

columns.name: sessions_per_day
columns.description: Number of separate app/website sessions opened per day. Range: 1 to 20.

columns.name: avg_session_duration_min
columns.description: Average duration of a single social media session in minutes.

columns.name: preferred_device
columns.description: Primary device used for accessing social media. Values: Smartphone, Laptop, Tablet, Desktop, Smart TV.

columns.name: peak_usage_time
columns.description: Time of day when the user is most active on social media. Values: Morning (6-10am), Afternoon (12-4pm), Evening (6-9pm), Night (9pm-12am), Late Night (12am+).

columns.name: followers_count
columns.description: Number of followers the user has on their primary platform. Range: 0 to ~5,000,000.

columns.name: following_count
columns.description: Number of accounts the user follows on their primary platform. Range: 0 to 10,000.

columns.name: posts_per_week
columns.description: Average number of posts or content pieces published by the user per week. Range: 0 to 50.

columns.name: likes_given_per_day
columns.description: Average number of likes or reactions the user gives to other posts per day. Range: 0 to 200.

columns.name: comments_per_day
columns.description: Average number of comments the user posts per day. Range: 0 to 50.

columns.name: shares_per_day
columns.description: Average number of posts the user shares or reposts per day. Range: 0 to 30.

columns.name: dms_sent_per_day
columns.description: Average number of direct messages sent by the user per day. Range: 0 to 100.

columns.name: preferred_content_type
columns.description: Type of content the user most frequently consumes. Values: Videos, Reels/Shorts, Photos, Stories, Memes, News, Educational, Entertainment.

columns.name: scroll_speed
columns.description: Typical scrolling behavior when browsing social media feeds. Values: Slow, Medium, Fast.

columns.name: ad_click_rate
columns.description: Proportion of advertisements clicked by the user out of total ads shown. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

columns.name: purchased_via_social_media
columns.description: Whether the user has purchased products or services via social media. Values: Yes, No, Sometimes.

columns.name: monthly_spend_via_social_usd
columns.description: Estimated monthly spending in USD on purchases made through social media. 0 for non-buyers.

columns.name: primary_purpose
columns.description: Main reason the user uses social media. Values: Entertainment, Networking, News & Updates, Business/Marketing, Learning, Socializing.

columns.name: sleep_disruption
columns.description: Self-reported impact of social media use on the user sleep quality. Values: No impact, Mild impact, Moderate impact, Severe impact.

columns.name: self_reported_mental_health_score
columns.description: User self-rated mental health score on a scale of 1 (Very Poor) to 10 (Excellent).

columns.name: screen_time_concern
columns.description: Whether the user is personally concerned about the amount of time they spend on social media. Values: Yes, No, Somewhat.

columns.name: notification_frequency
columns.description: App notification settings chosen by the user. Values: Always On, Selected, Do Not Disturb, Off.

columns.name: privacy_setting
columns.description: Profile visibility setting on the primary platform. Values: Public, Friends Only, Private.

columns.name: influencer_status
columns.description: Whether the user qualifies as an influencer based on follower count (greater than 10,000 followers). Values: Yes, No.

columns.name: account_join_date
columns.description: Date the user joined their primary social media platform. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Range: 2022-01-01 to 2024-12-31.

columns.name: mood_while_scrolling
columns.description: Typical mood the user reports experiencing while browsing social media. Values: Happy, Neutral, Stressed, Relaxed, Bored, Inspired.

columns.name: takes_social_media_breaks
columns.description: Whether the user intentionally takes breaks or digital detox periods from social media. Values: Yes, No, Occasionally.
